38948383.title: File:Joint Forces Command - United Assistance celebrates Thanksgiving in Liberia 141127-A-YF937-175.jpg

ObjectName.value: Joint Forces Command - United Assistance celebrates Thanksgiving in Liberia 141127-A-YF937-175

Categories.value: PD US Army|United States Agency for International Development|Operation United Assistance|Files created by the United States Army with known IDs|Images from DoD uploaded by Fæ|2014 in Monrovia|Ebolavirus DoD images|United States military in Monrovia|Liberia photographs taken on 2014-11-27

ImageDescription.value: Sgt. Steven Jordan, left, chef leader, and Spc. Christopher Massey, right, cook, both with Headquarters Support Company, Headquarters and Headquarters Battalion, 101st Airborne Division (Air Assault), Joint Forces Command – United Assistance, grill steak as part of a Thanksgiving dinner feast for other service members of JFC-UA deployed to Barclay Training Center, Monrovia, Liberia, Nov. 27, 2014. The BTC Thanksgiving dinner included turkey, steak, potato wedges, sweet potato casserole, gravy and six different flavors of pie. Operation United Assistance is a Department of Defense operation in Liberia to provide logistics, training and engineering support to U.S. Agency for International Development-led efforts to contain the Ebola virus outbreak in western Africa. (U.S. Army photo by Spc. Caitlyn Byrne, 27th Public Affairs Detachment/RELEASED)
